reviews.text: Our first visit with our new puppy, Bran. A wonderful, friendly environment with an amazing team of professionals. Thank you
Great veterinary clinic, staff and doctors very kind and competent and the structure itself is very modern, clean and welcoming

We’ve had a really positive experience with the Creature Comforts Chiswick team. Sandra and everyone there are caring, reliable and genuinely attentive to the dogs they look after.

Santo is only one and full of energy, while Lula is 14 and needs a gentler approach, so it means a lot to us that both are looked after so well and according to their individual needs.

The best recommendation probably comes from the dogs themselves — whenever we walk past, they both try to head straight inside! Although, to be fair, the treats might have something to do with it. 😂

It gives us complete peace of mind knowing they’re in such good hands. A lovely, trustworthy team that we would happily recommend to anyone looking for excellent pet care..

Just became a member and came for first appointment for my cat, the staff were all so lovely and our appointment with Jo was great she really made my nervous cat at ease and had lots of advice and answered my questions. I couldn’t recommend this practice more.
Great service, fun environment in a good location and knowledgeable and friendly people! Pure dog Coco loves the treats and attention! Highly recommend.

We go to Creature Comfort in Chiswick and we have done for years , we are obsessed with our mini schnauzer Vito and we simply wouldn’t trust him with anyone else. The service is always very friendly professional and I would struggle to find anything negative to say about them.

We booked our cat Eva for a vaccination course, but the clinic arranged the second appointment outside the required 4-week window — something they later acknowledged in writing. We only found out the window had expired once we arrived: we travelled by pet taxi and waited 20 minutes before being told. We were offered an off-label vaccination that day, which we declined, or restarting the whole course — meaning more visits and stress for Eva, because of their booking error.

We cancelled our membership and asked for reimbursement of the pet taxi costs (four journeys total), which was refused. The clinic described about £130 of "goodwill," but this included a waived cancellation fee and £85 for a vaccination that was never given — in our view, not charging for something you never provided isn't compensation.

We also found the waiting area not especially cat-friendly (cats and dogs share the same space, noisy, both visits delayed), and felt the complaint was handled without much acknowledgement of the stress this caused Eva. Creature Comforts is pricier than other local vets, and we expected that to mean better organisation and care — unfortunately that wasn't our experience.

They clearly told me on the phone, consulation, X-ray and dentistry can be done on the same day. I got the day off from my work, got my very difficult to catch cat, and went there early in the morning. Nobody was aware I was there for dentistry. Then the reception told me it cannot be done on the same day. Then they told me we cannot proceed because they don't have the medical records. Then they told me the cat needs to be fasted but nobody told me that. Then they showed me a price double of what they told me on the phone. This costed me a day from work + Uber rides + lots of stress for my cat. This branch has a serious communication problem. They obviously are not aware what each other is doing, and the records not kept properly.

Booked our cat's annual vaccination membership here.

First shot went fine, but the clinic then booked a follow-up appointment on the wrong schedule so we need to do the whole course again — we found out only after arriving, having already waited 20+ minutes on both visits...

Our cat, who doesn't do well around barking dogs in a shared waiting area, went through two stressful visits for nothing.

Promised a callback that never came. And in general acted like nothing special happened and straight away were more focused on fees I'll pay to cancel the subscription versus trying to acknowledge the issue and find the option

To their credit, once outreached by ourselves and pushed back they cancelled the membership with no cancellation fee and refunded the last charge — but they wouldn't cover the transport costs from the appointment their own team had booked incorrectly

Jo made Chester's first just so much more relaxed than at our previous vets. Very happy with our consultation.
Thank you

Fantastic, friendly staff and experience. The place has a spa-for-animals vibe, warm and spacious.

After recent surgeries, doubling down on the above!
Always kind and efficient, my cat is always in good hands.

I have been using Creature Comforts in Chiswick for a several months now and it’s been great so far! Very easy to get appointments and the staff have been so caring! Took my ragdoll in as she has developed some matting that I couldn’t brush out myself and within a day the appointment was booked and they shaved it out! No additional costs as I pay monthly. I wish I’d caught the veterinary nurse’s name as she was so lovely!!
Super Professional!! Loved it!!!

I wouldn’t recommend this practice based on my experiences. I’ve had two negative experiences with two different pets, both of which left me concerned about the level of clinical oversight and attention to detail. On both occasions, important clinical issues were missed, which was particularly disappointing and concerning. The practice is lovely-looking, but unfortunately the standard of clinical care I experienced did not match the impression the practice gives. After two separate experiences, I would not feel comfortable using them again.

My cat was diagnosed with FIP in June and has recently completed his treatment.  Creature Comforts and Dr Mimi have been huge supports in helping us navigate this difficult time.  Pricing was transparent, flexible, and very reasonable considering a lot of testing could be done in-house.  Jupiter loves going to the vet and he always feels so comfortable there.  On our most recent visit he took a nap whilst his brother was getting his bloods done.  Always a stress free experience for Jupiter; thank you to the team.

My beloved cat Julie passed away on 14th August after her condition became critical and, sadly, there was no treatment or cure available.

During such a heartbreaking and difficult time, Dr Isabel, the Veterinary Surgeon, handled everything with incredible kindness, compassion and professionalism. She took the time to comfort and reassure me that letting Julie go peacefully was the kindest decision, so that she would no longer be suffering or in pain.

I am incredibly grateful to Dr Isabel and all the staff members for the care, understanding and support they showed both Julie and me during such an emotional time.

Julie was part of my life for 18 years and meant so much to me. Saying goodbye was incredibly difficult, but the compassion shown by Dr Isabel and the team made those final moments more peaceful and bearable.

Thank you sincerely for everything you did for Julie and for the kindness you showed us. I will always be grateful. ❤️🐾
Very friendly and welcoming team of professionals . The place has a lots of space and very clean
Top class care, immaculate waiting room and consultation room, very calming atmosphere and very kind, helpful and caring staff
Wow what a vets! Caring, kind, generous and compassionate.
Having had an awful experience at another local vets my experience at creature comforts is as different as it could possibly be . My cat loves coming here and all the vets are wonderful

I get amazing care for my puppy. The staff are wonderfully friendly and the facility is impressively clean The vets always show true professionalism and compassion. Recently my puppy suffered a medical emergency. Dr Mimi  really looked after her when it mattered most, ensuring a full recovery.
I will be forever grateful.

We took our dog to Creature Comforts in Chiswick yesterday and feel I have to put something in writing to say thank you. We received absolutely exceptional care from start to finish - Hattie, the vet, was calm and kind. She spent time answering all of my questions never once making me feel rushed and all the while making friends with my dog so that when she delivered his rabies jab he was calm and unfazed. Hattie was ably assisted by the student nurse who held him while Hattie did the jab and his anal glands! Thank you both for such a lovely visit - we can’t wait to come back!!

Amazing level of care and transparency ! As a pet owner I felt at home , where everyone is so friendly and supportive when providing care for my pets! Well done to all of you , and please keep going! You all prove that a pet is more than an animal- they are family members! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ a

Had a very difficult month after my 18 yo cat fell ill. I first visited another vet along the high road but was not reassured by the service I got.

Very glad I made the switch to Creature Comfort. I went first time on 20 Jul to see if anything can be done because the symptoms are getting worse. Dr Elaine was empathetic and listened carefully to all my concerns. She was really assertive and gave me the hard truth when I was in denial to be honest. I went again on 30 Jul where I was lucky again to meet Elaine who told me that perhaps it is time to say good bye and booked me in for the next day just in case. I can only say I am glad she did this.

I went again today 31 Jul to say goodbye to my beloved cat and I met Dr Sandra. Frankly, I doubt there could ever be any vet that surpass the level of care and respect she gave to us and our cat. She took the time to talk with us and let us vent all we need. She did all she needs with our cat in his little pram so that he stayed calm. He came out with a little blanket on him. An additional blanket was added as his little pillow. Dr Sandra did the whole procedure in his pram. She removed the tubes but left the bandage on just so we do not need to see the wound. This is not something you can do unless you are a true pet lover. I cannot be more grateful for the way she handled this.

The clinical experience aside, the administrative support I received whenever I need to squeeze in for an appointment, order medicine, ask questions was excellent and staff was really trying to help. The app itself is handy when you are too sad to call.

I joined the all inclusive membership but was sadly not able to use it for the entire year and was just first month into it. After I put my baby to sleep, staff was kind enough to let me know the membership is automatically cancelled so that I have nothing to worry about any more.

I could not recommend creature comforts chiswick more.

We had a wonderful experience. The team was incredibly caring, kind, and professional throughout the whole process of preparing our dog’s travel paperwork. They made what could have been a stressful process feel smooth and straightforward, and were always patient and happy to answer our questions. We truly appreciated the compassionate service and highly recommend this clinic. Thank you so much!

I would strongly advise anyone considering  Creature Comforts Chiswick subscription to review very carefully. For a couple of years I received repeated emails, texts and calls encouraging me to join their subscription plan. I eventually enrolled and took my healthy dog in for routine vaccinations. During that first appointment the focus quickly shifted to recommending a dental clean and I was sent an estimate of £571.50 - £759.58. A few days later someone from the practice called and I informed them that I felt uncomfortable at the hard sell I'd received, and that on returning home I realised my dog had an ear infection which had been missed due to the vet's preoccupation with my dog's teeth. I said that I had made a mistake and wanted to terminate the agreement whenever possible. Although I did not realise at the time, I was within my rights to cancel then without penalty, however I was not informed of this and instead she booked me in for another appointment with a different vet. At that appointment, I was told that my dog either had a hair or grass seed in his ear canal and that they would need to put him under anaesthetic to remove it. It was also suggested that I put my dog on hypoallergenic food to prevent ear infections, even though there was no issue with his current food. On introducing the new food my elderly dog became very unwell and his weight plummeted. His stomach is now oversensitive and I am having issues trying to get him back to health. I have returned to my old vet even though CCV continue to take a monthly payment, ignore my emails and suggest that I pay them £165.  I believe the monthly subscription is an effective strategy which encourages visits, where they can suggest unnecessary, expensive treatments, however more importantly I took in a healthy dog and have unfortunately been left dealing with health problems following their advice, that has been both distressing and expensive.

Can’t fault our first experience at Creature Comforts with my 8 month old whippet puppy. So thorough and Dr Mimi was  just the best vet you could ask for. Coming from medivet, it’s just a completely different experience. Just to add how sterile the whole practice is & you get a nice little welcome pack from the lovely receptionist.

He has since had surgery there and it went swimmingly, again can’t fault them. I recommend to ALL my dog walking clients in Acton & Chiswick.

First visit. Brilliant team, efficient processing and lovely reception area. Our nervous cat calmed down within minutes and loved being ‘handled’ by Dr Sandra. The registration process with a real human via phone won me over and was a breeze - unlike all the online options. 5 🐾

It has been a year and we still cannot believe how lucky we were to find this team. 10 out od 5 stars! Thank you all!
I love this vet practice. They are really helpful and vets are knowledgable and have time for you.
The team look after Ember (kitten/cat) really well. They know her and take really good care with her. Plus it’s a super handy location on the high rd. With a good payment plan too.

Excellent pet first aid event with Creature Comforts. Hugely informative a useful. Just part of the personalised attention to paw parents and their very important fur children. One feels safe with the Creature Comforts team. Bravo

What I love MOST about Creature Comforts , is how much everyone who works there genuinely loves animals ! The waiting area is spacious and attractive , the consulting areas are light and airy and not at all scary for all the “ patients “.  My ( nearly 6yr old) cockapoo , Ellie ADORES coming to C’Comforts …. And all “ patients parents “ can get a lovely cuppa !!!Recently,   I embarrassed myself by crying as I was worried about Ellie ,who needed an anaesthetic and procedure … BUT I wasn’t treated like a mad old fart …. but , as a worried  “dog mum” ! ( Incidentally she’s healing nicely …. but I’m still a worried Mum !! Obviously!! ) i cannot recommend Creature Comforts highly enough - they truly love their calling !!

My pup enters the clinic wiggling his half body!, the staff greet him like loyalty, Irie loves them.
We are very happy with their services, they are caring, professional, and welcoming.

First visit, made me and kittens feel welcome, vet was very informative about my kittens and gave good advice. Asked if I had any questions which I didn't and don't as yet, but we're very kind and sweet to the little ones and didn't say anything about the baby kitty having an accident in carrier just assisted with, clean up. All in all would recommend.

From the begging it’s just money rolling place! We had our puppy problems with stomach,but they should just suggest to change the food,instead they took samples for this and for that but no issues was solved. Came back for the vaccinations and they start to insist to make more checks which obviously we need to pay for… the end -£500 on our account and we change the food all everything was great with our puppy. So if you have an extra money that’s your place.
I spoke to a receptionist today around 5.45pm and genuinely was most amazing, helpful and extremely knowledgeable!! I wish i took her name!! She has a heart of gold!!! Thank u!!
Amazing place. Love it ! Really modern and professional approach.

Great vets.  The practice itself, is very clean, smells nice and is a comfortable place to be.  The staff are all very kind and friendly, it seems they enjoy their work and looking after the animals that come in which is obviously very comforting to any pet owner.  I also just discovered my favourite vet, Sandra is here, which is an added bonus!  She saved my cat from more years of misery with a simple medication that I had never been offered before.
This vet is the best!!!!! Super friendly and recommend a help you a sometimes genarous,if your animal needs help,creature comforts is the best
My wife and I have taken our two girls to this lovely vets and the staff there have been so kind, professional and caring.
A wonderful, welcoming and knowledgeable practice. My girl is always so calm before, during and after every visit - such a smooth experience every time for a nervous pet owner.
Lovely vet clinic, staff are welcoming and the vets are knowledgeable, I have no complaints
I was super impressed with the care and friendliness of all the staff. Our cat always gets the best service here. Thank you

My Cat Prince Dolce was feeling unwell for a few days. After an amazing customer service at reception, Dr Hazel Maw accurately visited him and after some medication he showed major improvement within 30 minutes we were back home.

When we left the clinic, lovely Erica gifted Dolce with treats and the perfect bandana.
Here a picture of him wearing it!

I highly recommend CC vet Chiswick and I’m giving a full 5 stars.

Great vet!! Called as soon as they opened because my cat had a laceration on her left eye the night before, they straight away booked me in, just 20 minutes later I was in the consultation and everything was sorted. Very professional and very fair pricing. Definitely recommend going here
One of the best vets I have come across. Upfront costs and the vets are very friendly and knowledgeable

Excellent vet practice. Our dog genuinely enjoys going, so much so that whenever we walk along the high road she pulls to go inside. We are on the membership plan which has really saved us a lot of money!
Hattie, Erika and the team looked after us so well. Highly recommended
Everyone here is so friendly and helpful. The reception team are welcoming and kind, as are the vets. Thank you!

Creature Comforts Chiswick are great, the staff are friendly and helpful. There are also thoughtful touches such as mobile phone charging pads for pawrents.

However, the real reason we go there is for the most wonderful vet on the planet! Mimi is amazing, she is calm and explains things so well. Our dog is our only child and is an anxious rescue from Kefelonia … she is so gentle and caring with him and doesn’t make us feel like we are neurotic parents.  I have never felt so comfortable nor trusted a vet like I do Mimi and it brings such peace of mind.  Thank you Mimi!
Very lovely experience, clean environment and friendly staff
The team at this Chiswick branch are absolutely amazing. So warm and friendly and helpful. I’ve had the best service and excellent care for my dog every single time.

The whole team at creature comforts Chiswick were incredible ahead of a minor surgery for my dog. Dr Prickett was amazing and so attentive and communicative. The practice as a whole is so welcoming and an actual pleasure to be in which is not always the case with vets. I can’t recommend it highly enough, most importantly they treat the animals with the utmost care and seem genuinely thrilled by seeing the pets and especially familiar faces. More importantly all the dogs loved being there!

Thank you to everyone at Creature Comforts Chiswick for the care shown to Milly, my 15-year-old cockapoo. When the time came to say goodbye to her in April, Emily, Mimi and Erica were all very kind and professional, and handled everything with great compassion. I’m very grateful to the whole team for the care and support they provided throughout the last couple of years.

Brilliant service at creature comforts today.The reception staff were super helpful and welcoming. Sandra was fantastic, super helpful and made my usually shy/nervous cat feel at ease. Many thanks from Adele and Crumpet🐾 …

First visit and the best vet experience ever! The clinic is so calming and welcoming and my dogs could not believe the healthy treats on offer! Our vet took alot of time to help my nervous dog who is always terrified of the vets. So glad we found you!

I was really happy from the day I walked in to enquire if I could make an appointment and for the reasons I had. Being a first time fur baby mum comes with multiple worries from minor to major. All my concerns were met with patience and answers that were clear to me. No scary ,  pricey investigations No huge potential price tags. Just guidance , understanding and a deep knowledge of their skills.
Friendly staff , the vets fully inform you off costs and they took great care of my dog , would definitely recommend them.

I would like to thank all the team at Creature comforts, Chiswick for their outstanding care towards my little boy Charlie who had lymphoma and left us yesterday for doggy heaven. We will miss him so much. I would like to thank Nina, who guided us through this very difficult time, who allowed us to spend time with Charlie, giving him a dignified ending.

I would also like to thank the teams at St, John's wood and Nottinghill for the care and support towards Charlie boy as well.

You are all amazing vets and please continue being the best of the best 👌

I’m very happy using Creature Comforts Vets, As soon as you get to the door you’re welcome with a  friendly member of staff, very friendly atmosphere, very professional very clean, plenty of doggy treats they really go above and beyond👍 …
They were just brilliant. Come doubling as interstellar satellite

By far the most amazing vets! They make a vet visit a whole experience, with pick and mix treats, goodie bags and most importantly the warm, friendly and welcome atmosphere the team create. The veterinarians are so caring and knowledgeable and we are so happy to have joined in Chiswick. Sonny LOVES to visit here.

We joined Creature Comforts in Chiswick a few months ago as our old vets had changed ownership. We had been with them for over 15 years so they knew us and vice versa very well. But when we joined CC we instantly felt welcomed and listened too. We have had a few encounters recently as our little maltese terrier is getting older and she has had a few tummy  issues. CC were very professional and thorough and they are also patient and kind with sometimes over anxious pet parents. I would absolutely recommend CC to other pet owners. Thank you CC for all your kindness shown to Lulu.
Super friendly & really helpful 👍🏼 …

Blu loves her visits here and the entire team are genuinely wonderful.

Attentive to Blu and not intrusive, the best move and the package, app and communication is incredible too.

They're honest about every option, no pressure and this really is the best vets we've ever used...Blu also loves taking a Tennis Ball home on every trip.

We love our local team at Chiswick and its always a pleasure to see them too.
Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review Filipa!

Thank you so much for giving Frankie the best chance he had. We really appreciate the effort and kindness all team showed to our little friend ❤️ We can definitely recommend the Creature Comfort team for truly care for every fluffy life 😻 …

We switched vet’s to creature comforts over a year ago and we’ve only had great experiences. The membership works well for our beloved pooch who is growing older, it gives us peace of mind that we can pop in easily when we need advice or reassurance. The vets and all staff are wonderful and look after our dog with care and affection.  Thank you ☺️

My dog was recently attacked in daycare and everyone at Creature Comforts has been amazing! The woman I spoke to over the phone was so helpful to get my dog in as soon as possible and the vet was incredibly thorough and reassuring. The receptionist was amazing and helped us with our insurance claim and made such a fuss of our dog. Our dog is an always a huge fan of going to this vet!

Creature comforts are awesome! From the moment you walk through the door, you know your pet is in good hands. We are on the All Access membership, so with the free consultation, means I am able to bring my dog in at anytime when I am concerned , just for a chat or a quick examination and not be worried about an expensive consultation fee.
You can really tell that the whole team loves animals and their customer service is excellent.
I can not recommend them enough!

Best vet experience ever. Was getting my travel documents done with them for my cat travelling to the UAE and they helped me through and through even when things needed amending on the day. Super helpful, accurate, efficient, polite and all round excellent service. Regret moving only because I cannot have them as my cats vet. Staff super sweet and accommodating.
The best vet around chiswick. Lovely people, amazing and super competent doctors. Absolutely 100% worth it.

I cannot  thank the team at Creature Comforts Chiswick enough! My Border Collie, Meg, has always been nervous about going to the vets and never enjoyed her visits in the past. However, the staff here are so incredibly patient and caring!  Between the lovely atmosphere and the endless supply of treats and tennis balls, she actually enjoys coming to see them now! I highly recommend them to any owners with nervous pets! 💜
Fabulous service felt as if they cared for my pet would definitely recommend

If you’re looking for a vet in the area look no further, Creature Comforts is the best. We’ve now been to a couple consultations with different vets and they’re all so lovely. Whether it’s a routine examination or a vaccine, they always share all the information we need to know and they’re so loving and kind to our little kitten!💜 …

I had a very bad experience with my little cat and had to rush him to the vets. I live in Chiswick so we took him to creature come first I saw Nina she was so amazing with my little cat. We had to go back and Nina saw him again and unfortunately Tiggy had to go the the cat heaven in the sky. I must say the staff were wonderful made us feel it was the correct decision for him We can’t thank them enough for there kindness and support given to us from the staff I would recommend them as the best.

Brought a friend's pup in for routine vaccinations with Dr Kiekie today and had such an easy experience. The team was expecting us when we arrived, greeting the dog by name to make him feel comfortable immediately. We went into the examination room where he got some love, treats, and jabs, and we were out of there very quickly. Dr Kiekie was so gentle and loving with him, I'm pretty sure he thinks he was just there to visit a pal. The clinic is beautiful, clearn, and very modern. It smells like a luxury spa which creates a very relaxing environment. Already looking forward to our next visit.
The most caring and professional pet care team I’ve seen to date! Cannot recommend them more!
Really well looked after, very caring vets.

I cannot recommend Dr Penny at Creature Comforts (Chiswick) highly enough. She has an exceptional way of explaining everything clearly and thoroughly, taking the time to ensure you fully understand your pet’s condition and the available options.

What really stands out is her depth of knowledge combined with a practical, sensible approach — you feel completely confident that your pet is in expert hands. She is calm, professional, and genuinely caring, which makes what can often be a stressful situation much easier to navigate.

An outstanding veterinary surgeon and a real asset to the practice.

My experience of the Creature Comforts (Chiswick) team has also been positive and helpful. I have, without hesitation, recommended this practice to friends.
A gentle and calming experience for our anxious cat! I am so glad we foung Creature Comforts!

Perfectly located in centre of Chiswick with easy access. Very clean and professional service and my Cat loves roaming in the waiting area. Great welcoming staff, with Penny looking after my cat over the year. Thank you .
Thanks so much for your review Angeliki. We're glad you had such a positive experience and look forward to seeing you soon!
Clean, friendly and knowledgeable.

Thank you to the all staff at Creature Comforts in Chiswick. We got to our appointment today and the staff as well as the establishment are warm and welcoming. Its also spacious and clean and smells of lovely lavender.  Cali loves her appointments with all the treats that go with it.

Can’t recommend Creature Comforts Vet enough! Everyone there is so kind, welcoming, and incredibly caring. They genuinely care about each pet that comes in and take the time to make both pets and owners feel at ease.

We are lucky to have Dr. Emily looking after our cat’s health. She is professional, patient, and friendly. The front desk staff are also very helpful. This is the best vet I have ever visited. Highly recommended.
Amazing vets, really helpful caring staff members. Sandra assisted us and made us as well as our kitten welcome! Really glad we chose Creature Comforts!!
Excellent care and our Chester was over the moon! Felt more like a doggie spa than vet

We have a membership with Creature Comforts Chisick for our Beagle Billie. In the last couple of months we've reached out for help and they have accommodated our needs. One time was organising a prescription for our dogs medication when we had left it at home whilst holidaying. Recently when a bone became lodged in our dogs mouth after one call we received an emergency appt and billie was met with such care and kindness. Thanks to all the team for all your help.

Unfortunately, our first visit to Creature Comforts in Chiswick was a very sad one, as we had to say goodbye to our beloved cat.
However, I cannot praise the team enough. From the very first minute we were greeted by a polite and professional receptionist, then we saw a nurse and finally a vet (Dr. Nina I believe) - I am so sorry for forgetting the name of the receptionist and the nurse (though I think the nurse's name might be Rachel, apologies if I got that wrong). They remained professional throughout our visit and provided comfort and support.
Most importantly, the care they showed to our pet was outstanding. Additionally, their care and professionalism felt authentic and did not come across as trained behaviour executed at a place of work, which personally matters a lot to me.
I'd like to thank the whole team, that despite sad and heartbreaking circumstances, they created a safe atmosphere for pets and their owners.
Great experience! Easy to book appointments, reception staff are very friendly, and the vets are friendly and provide great advice as well as giving guidance to first time pet owners!

Fantastic team at Creature Comforts in Chiswick! Everyone is so nice. Also it’s been very easy to get an appointment within a day or two which was an issue with previous vet practices. Can’t recommend these guys enough!

I’ve been to many vets over my 60 years of pet ownership and this one stands out for the friendly ambience, genuine care and compassion and a consultation that is both thorough, unhurried and professional. I’ve done much research on senior cats various ailments and medications and Emily was absolutely spot on with her suggestions and advice going forwards. Baker the Cat also received a complimentary gift pack of toys and food supplements as we left. It’s said that first impressions are usually reliable and my conclusion is that Creature Comforts are a pets Paradise of which I’ve just made Baker a member…. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

We’ve been taking our dog Louis since they first opened, and they’ve been amazing from day one! The staff are absolutely brilliant, super friendly, helpful, and clearly love what they do. It’s always such a warm, welcoming vibe whenever we walk in (Louis practically drags us there!). They’ve always looked after him with so much care, and we couldn’t be more grateful or impressed. If your pet deserves the best (and of course they do!)this is the best place to go in the Chiswick area!

Update on most recent visit to Chiswick to see Dr Penny. A hugely warm welcome from the team who all recognised jetta my dog and me even thought they aren’t our local vet we only go to see Dr Penny, Jetta’s orthopaedic surgeon. Everything runs on time, clean, modern practice.  Everyone makes time for toy.

Delighted to have sign off after major TPLO surgery 4 months ago.  Dr Penny was extremely clear on what was expected of us as owners and carers following surgery and without this I doubt Jetta would have made such a miraculous recovery.

Thank you to all the team at creature comforts Chiswick.  Happy new year!

Extremely happy with our latest visit to Creature Comforts in Chiswick where we saw Dr Penny, their orthopaedic surgeon.  The team are extremely friendly and always offer a drink on arrival.  They are all very kind to my dog.  The clinic is clean and modern.  Dr Penny is excellent, no nonsense but also realistic.

Thank you so much, we are so pleased we moved vets after our dog's accident.  For 9 years we received very poor service at our previous vet.  You have certainly raised the bar

Brilliant service with true creature comforts at its heart.
My cat has been seen multiple times with no additional cost as I pay monthrly membership fees. Thank you

It can't be denied that the vet industry can be a ruthless business. Expensive yes. If you are going to spend your hard earnt funds you want a vet who actually cares about animals , where your pet isn't just a number or an appointment slot ... Creature Comforts is exactly that .. I can genuinely see that they love and adore working with animals, they show sincere and pure hearted interest in seeing your pet get better. They have on various occasions followed up to check on how pets were doing when they didn't need to, they offer advice that is motivated by truth as opposed to ££.

Emily is an absolute asset to this clinic, she is lovely and welcoming, amazingly positive energy ; the appointment always feels natural, not rushed. The lady in reception is also a sweetheart, ALWAYS smiling, always polite, always friendly.

It's a fantastic team and the smart thing they've done is kept it familiar faces. So when you bring your pets in you are not dealing with a constant new person.

I would highly highly recommend them. The clinic is a warm atmosphere. I came from Village Vet and if I'm frank their waiting room feels more like a dentist. Creature Comforts layout is ALOT nicer. Do not hesitate to go with this vet. It's been nothing but a 10/10 experience. A million times better than the others.

His symptoms did not improve at all.
I repeatedly asked for his teeth to be checked, knowing dental issues are a common cause of these symptoms in rabbits, but I was reassured multiple times that his teeth were “perfectly fine.” This was later proven to be incorrect.
After seeking a second opinion, another vet immediately identified a dental problem during the very first examination. My rabbit required dental surgery, after which his symptoms fully resolved. It is upsetting to know that he underwent unnecessary procedures, stress, and anaesthesia (at 7 years old) due to what I believe was poor clinical judgment.
What makes this even worse is that the practice never bothered to respond to my formal complaint email. The complete lack of accountability or basic decency to reply is shocking and speaks volumes.
I spent approximately £1,400 on treatment that failed to address the real problem. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this practice, especially for rabbit or exotic pet care.
